approval_id.description: The approval request waiting, if one is.

checks.description: A draft's status: ✖ while no evidence is attached.

evidence.description: How many files are attached and not removed: asking for approval needs one, such as the leaver's notice.

grant_id.description: The grant whose options it takes (getOptionGrant).

kind.description: forfeiture: options not vested, given up when the holder leaves; expiry: options that lapse, at the grant's expiry or once a leaver's window to exercise closes.

number.description: The options it takes, a whole number above zero: at most what the grant leaves, and for a forfeiture at most what is not vested on its day.

on.description: The day the options are forfeited or lapse, on or after the grant date; from it they are back in the pool.

recorded_by.description: Who approved it, as it was recorded.

status.description: draft: waiting for its evidence and approval; recorded: in the register.

version.description: The version of its content; with its status it makes the ETag.
